该研究在人类肾细胞癌（RCC）患者（CheckMate 025 试验，n=394 nivolumab 组）的血浆代谢组分析中，发现肌苷（inosine）水平与免疫检查点阻断（ICB）治疗后的总生存期（OS）显著相关（高肌苷组中位 OS 33 个月 vs 低肌苷组 22 个月），且这种关联在依维莫司对照组中不存在。
研究揭示了肌苷增强 ICB 疗效的分子机制：肌苷直接进入肿瘤细胞，抑制泛素激活酶 UBA6 的活性，从而解除其对炎症信号和抗原呈递通路的抑制，提高肿瘤细胞对 T 细胞介导杀伤的敏感性。
研究指出肌苷在人体血浆中的测量存在技术挑战，因为腺苷可快速降解为肌苷（约 10 秒）且在体内清除快，而肌苷半衰期较长（约 15 小时），这可能影响血浆肌苷浓度的准确测定。
在人类肿瘤组织队列（n=22，抗 PD1 治疗）中，肿瘤细胞 UBA6 蛋白表达水平与 ICB 响应（ORR：低 UBA6 组 50% vs 高 UBA6 组 17%）及 CD8+ T 细胞浸润呈负相关，作为肌苷下游效应的替代标志物。

This study provides clinical evidence that oral inosine supplementation (0.2 g, three times/day) combined with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors significantly prolonged median progression-free survival (7.00 vs 4.40 months; HR 0.63, p = 0.011) compared to inhibitors alone in 172 patients with advanced solid tumors. Although the objective response rate (26.7% vs 15.1%) did not reach statistical significance (p = 0.061), the data establish a clinical association between exogenous inosine exposure and improved ICI outcomes (PFS). Subgroup analyses indicated stronger PFS benefits in lung cancer patients (HR 0.45) and those with specific inflammatory markers (e.g., LDH≥216, NLR<4), suggesting patient stratification factors relevant to metabolite efficacy.

This review identifies inosine and short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) as key microbial metabolites influencing immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) efficacy. It reports that elevated fecal levels of acetate, propionate, butyrate, and valerate are associated with prolonged progression-free survival (PFS) and better treatment response in a prospective study of 52 solid tumor patients receiving anti-PD-1 therapy. It also cites evidence that high systemic butyrate and propionate levels correlate with CTLA-4 blockade resistance. Regarding inosine, the review describes a mechanism where B. pseudolongum-produced inosine translocates systemically to activate antitumor T cells and improve ICI efficacy.
